rationale: Alon's work on dexterous manipulation for humanoid robots and Tyler's spatial data infrastructure for physical AI are deeply complementary—robots performing complex hand-intensive tasks need rich 3D perception and environment understanding to operate effectively. Both founders are convicted that perception and manipulation capabilities are foundational for robotics at scale, and Tyler's platform could be a critical enabling layer for Aora's robot learning approach.
intro_message: Alon Ko, meet Tyler Raciti — you're both building core infrastructure for physical AI robots from different angles: Alon on dexterous manipulation via learning, Tyler on spatial data perception; worth exploring how your platforms could work together.
